# Ignored-thread localization moves the singular choice into Fluent and unifies notification identity

The notification always uses ignoreThreadsInfo and passes both the distinct-thread count and truncated subject. Fluent count variants replace the old JavaScript exact-size-one branch. The two updated test lookups check the subject and button count for individual thread/subthread cases; they do not add plural or long-subject coverage. Preserve the actual -theads IDs rather than inventing a spelling migration, and do not assume all-locale text equivalence.

Scope: Ignored thread notification localization.
